rows.title: P1 — DuckBrain v1.2.0 cut: AUTHORIZED by owner 2026-11-11 (minor cut = standing releng authority; owner gate released: 'approved on both' Oct 26 + Nov 1 decisions)
[P1] QA battery refused to launch — dispatch path is a subdirectory of parent git repo

P1 — Native suite ENOSPC disk capacity: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-11-11 — clear space on the BUNKERS and get them healthy; attach cleanup to the existing per-bunker space-management cron/thread. (Local main box also needs the sweep; tracked on HARDEN-DUCKBRAIN-002's compression process.)
[P1] Chaos disconnect test blocked by disk capacity (ENOSPC)
DuckBrain v1.2.0 readiness sweep 2026-11-01: authorization NOW GRANTED by owner 2026-11-11 (unblocked; sweep's other gates still apply: release surface + current GitReins verdict)
[P0] HARDENING LOOP (contract row) — drive DuckBrain to a stranger-proof state: reproduce every claimed boundary, fix it, prove with a control, deploy as the test

P1 — Live daemon's 9.2G data dir inside a git checkout: OWNER AUTHORIZED 2026-11-11 — run the standing checkout-compression/history-squash process on the live datadir checkout (total data is small; history is the bloat). Then keep the data-dir-outside-checkout migration on this row.

P1 — Deploy /metrics: OWNER AUTHORIZED 2026-11-11 the live :3000 daemon restart to enable metrics (owner: 'you can reset the daemon so metrics get enabled'). Restart, verify /metrics serves, then wire scrape + alert rules (fleet-monitor).

P1 — /api/memories 11% >=3s from FILE COUNT (20-29k jsonl/namespace): OWNER APPROVED the squash design — Cassandra-style tombstone compaction per the original specs: rebuild segments so file count stays bounded, reads stay fast. Automate the compaction (scheduled), don't make it a one-off.
P1 — Compact PRODUCTION namespaces (fleet-quality 29,080 files first): OWNER APPROVED 2026-11-11. Execute via the tombstone/squash process from PERF-DUCKBRAIN-001 and make it automated/recurring.

P1 — 17/37 live tokens ADMIN via optional roles: OWNER DIRECTIVE 2026-11-11 'figure it out on your own' — design + execute token role-tightening (default least-privilege, admin audit, rotate/derogate the 17) without further owner hand-holding.
[P1] One partition is 10,002 objects (one 46MB file plus ~10,000 three-line files) — a wildcard read over it needs ~10,000 GETs and does not finish in 5 minutes
IMPROVE OURS - Ship session-start memory injection as installable plugins for other agents, not only the Hermes provider
IMPROVE OURS - A key without a roles field is admin by default: 2/2 live keys are admin, 0 use table grants

P1 - v1.2.0 cut prep (rolling): NO CUT at 9f2ddbee (pass 19) - product tree byte-identical to the pass-17 candidate 00ca0bc2 (every commit since is board/ledger/evidence only); tip CI green (run 43741076346 + scheduled benchmark 43798883862); npm channel still E404 with 0 Actions secrets so a tag today orphans; PERF-015 attempt 3 in flight will move the tree; re-fire 2: tip b2bd7bb1, product-identical, CI 43879570797 green
DR restore discards namespace git history that is already in S3 — add `s3 sync <ns> pull --with-history`
Git-history mirror is opt-in per namespace with a silent skip and no status surface — 38 of 238 mapped namespaces have no history, including `hermes`
A partial push publishes a completeness ledger built only from what landed, so a DR pull reports a clean restore of an incomplete backup
Pull's only guard against overwriting newer local data is a non-atomically written local manifest — a missing or corrupt manifest silently turns pull into 'remote wins' with exit 0
MCP squash compacts the store with no admin role, no confirmation, and dryRun defaulting to false — HTTP refuses the identical call without admin + confirm
The parity matrix claims table.list on the CLI but `tables` dispatches only `declare` — and the parity test cannot see a CLI sub-verb unless the row declares a dispatcher
The MCP surface has no S3 and no ops tools — an agent can squash a namespace but cannot list or clear the ghosts it creates, run a sync, prune a namespace or consolidate
`query` exists on MCP and CLI but has no HTTP route, and the raw-SQL grant middleware it needs is exported and never mounted
Documented HTTP and CLI examples are never executed — add an executable claim-vs-live contract suite
The shipped binary announces two different versions and CI pins the stale one — `--version` says 1.2.0, `help` says 1.1.0, README badge says 1.1.0
Honor Idempotency-Key on table writes: replay returns the original result, conflicting body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, durable across restart

P1 — OWNER-GATED: push a v1.2.0 tag today and the Release workflow fails AFTER the tag is public — the repo has ZERO Actions secrets, so NPM_TOKEN is absent and 'Publish package to npm' dies before the GitHub Release step runs
CI red on main: src/s3/sync-stopped-s3stop001.test.ts:191 is same-millisecond flaky (lastPushAttemptAt === lastPushAt)

P1 — CLI `recall --prefix=

` silently returns the WHOLE namespace: the prefix never reaches the recall tool (44/44 rows vs 9 on REST and MCP)
[P1] cos.initiatives read view serves 619 of 927 board cards: rows older than the active segment can never be patched again and stay invisible (all 3 off-by-one initiative cards lost)
48% of the duckbrain open board is undispatchable: acceptance_gate reports 57 of 118 open rows failing (no command, no outcome, or unexpanded placeholders)
RECURRENCE of INT-CI-040: test-counts drift red since 18:30Z — 989625cb added a test case without regenerating the manifest

P1 — Move DuckBrain MCP from stdio to streamable-HTTP on the :3000 daemon (owner-approved 11-16): add MCP-over-HTTP endpoint to bin/duckbrain.js server startup (same tool surface as ), auth via existing x-api-key; flip Hermes config mcp_servers.duckbrain from command-wrapper form to url form; kill per-session stdio node+watchdog processes (pid 10215 pattern, one per session); verify n100 can connect over network. Do together with the live conformance bakeoff (same serving plane).

CI red on main run 45116477909 (head 5d3b5556, board-only commit; product tree identical to green run 04:58Z at fc70f922): suite-level teardown failure in src/cli/http-cors-example-app-001.test.ts — ENOTEMPTY rmdir '/tmp/cors-example-app-*/taskboard/.git/objects' under CI load; same rmdir-race class as TESTQ-2026-11-08-1.

disposition: The loop remains pending. Owner-gated rows are not self-authorized; dispatchable rows remain feeder backlog for subsequent ticks. No production restart, release/tag, or live-data rewrite was performed.
